description: List the `fsk_` project API keys, with their scopes, who created each, and whether it is expired or revoked. Key material is hashed and never listed. Needs a LOGIN TOKEN (FILLO_TOKEN or `npx @usefillo/cli login`) — a project API key may not enumerate keys, so a leaked one cannot map the workspace's credentials.
name: fillo_list_api_keys
title: List project API keys
